items.title: Jigger, what? SAND FLEAS!
items.text: Jigger, what? SAND FLEAS!
Had a dick, apparently...

I took a horrible trip down a rabbit hole, and stumbled across a treasure trove of jigger treatment videos. The main purpose is to educate and enlist aid to help fight/fund the infestation of jiggers. I can assure you, this poor soul is not the worse I have seen. The female sand flea burrows into the soft skin, sets up shop, and pumps out eggs. The cycle repeats, on and on.... necrosis is a result, if left untreated, but I believe the massive scarring above is just a result of poor hygiene, barefoot walking on dirt with open wounds, and god knows what else.
To prep for these videos, the subjects feet are soaked in some kind of solution to soften the skin before the slicing. I can’t watch any more of these videos...I just can’t.
I said, “GODDAMN!”

Yo, gotta wife who adores pugs, but we have had poor luck with them. I would like to commission some of your art. Please respond with a shop or whatever so I can throw money at you. She would lose her goddamn mind if I could get 2 pieces with clothes/costumes like above. Holy shit, I can’t adequately describe the fuck-ton of brownie points....
Meat curtains...
Ha! Goddamn “Mooshoo” is right up her alley. Alrighty then! Time to dig up some pics! You wouldn’t stitch two on one piece, would you? Bigger is fine, higher price is expected..
Fantastic, I will get on it!
Couldn’t watch, the glare from her buck-teeth was too distracting.
Beatsa Beatsa....new trade mark

Dudley Moore narrated the lives of a tabby kitten and a pug puppy. It was cute and reminiscent of older  Disney nature documentaries....with the exception of the live births of more puppies and kittens.  Some weird shit to see if you weren’t even remotely expecting it.
Edit: awww damn, research has once again ruined another childhood memory.... figgity fyuck the a-holes who made that movie. A lot of animals suffered to make that delightful comedic romp.

Same, I’m astounded by friendships that are decades long. A little envious, but thankfully my wife is a social butterfly and I get to glom onto her cliques.  “I Love You, Man”  hit me in my feels, then we moved again and I got over it....
